title: Freya Leach’s Sky News Australia program axed after airing anti-Islam guest wearing shirt covered in bacon
summary: Freya Fires Up night show cancelled but presenter to remain as co-host of a different program Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Sign up for Guardian Australia’s free weekly media newsletter here A Sky After Dark program which aired a highly offensive diatribe against Islam by a far-right guest wearing a shirt festooned with raw bacon rashers has been axed after six weeks on air. While the new Sunday night show, Freya Fires Up, has been cancelled, its presenter Freya Leach will remain as co-host of Sky’s the Late Debate, which airs four nights a week. Continue reading...
